role: Three LLM fact namespaces: routes.library.* (count/list saved routes, rename, save a recent GPS workout as a route, engage a saved route as turn-by-turn), app.now.* (UTC time, local date, timezone, weekday) and app.devices.* (Polar, foot pod/FTMS, Concept2 PM5, Zwift BLE broadcaster state).
types: RoutesLibraryNamespace: struct (FactNamespaceResolver, namespace 'routes', holds SessionArchive) — route library facts/actions
AppDevicesNamespace: struct (FactNamespaceResolver, namespace 'app') — connected hardware facts
toplevel: Each namespace is registered by AppFactResolverFactory.registerAppNamespaces (AppFactResolver.swift:214-216). Stored lets: namespace strings and RoutesLibraryNamespace.archive.

flags.text: No test exercises routes.library.rename/save_workout/engage, app.now.* or app.devices.* resolvers (grep of EmuquTests for these keys/types finds none).

units.does: Returns SavedRouteStore.routes (MainActor.assumeIsolated).

Asks SavedRouteStore.isLibraryReadable() (MainActor.assumeIsolated; retries a blocked read); nil when readable, else .missing(notRecorded) explaining the library can't be read right now (phone not unlocked since a restart, or the file is damaged), nothing was read or changed, ask again after unlocking.
Lists workout archive entries newest first: without a date the 20 most recent; with a yyyy-MM-dd date (FactLocalDay formatter) those on that local day; an unparseable date yields [].

branches.effect: returns [] → caller says 'no workout on <date>' instead of invalid parameter

units.does: Returns the first candidate whose lightweight session yields a SavedRoute (has a ≥2-point GPS polyline), with its entry; nil if none.

branches.cond: session fails to load or has no polyline
branches.effect: continue to next candidate; returns first match

units.does: Maps a SavedRoute to id/name/sport/created_at(ISO8601)/distance/ascent/descent/climb_count record.
Returns the 5 routes.library entries (count, list, rename, save_workout, engage).

branches.effect: returns ambiguousRoute (0 → notRecorded, >1 → invalidParameter); otherwise renames

units.does: Calls SavedRouteStore.rename(id:to:) on the main actor. When the store refuses (the library cannot be read), returns libraryUnreadable()'s .missing, or a .missing saying the rename could not be saved; otherwise returns status 'renamed' with id, old and new name.

branches.effect: .missing: libraryUnreadable()'s reason, else 'the rename could not be saved; nothing was changed'

units.does: Action entry 'routes.library.save_workout' (name, optional date) calling resolveRoutesLibrarySaveWorkout. Its description says that without a date it saves the newest of the 20 most recent workouts with a GPS polyline, and that a workout already in the library returns status 'already_saved'.
units.entry: fact closure runs when the LLM calls tool 'routes.library.save_workout' (FactResolverRegistry.resolveTool/resolveActionTool, FactResolverRegistry.swift:291/348); property read when the namespace's entries list is built

units.does: Validates name, refuses with libraryUnreadable's .missing while the library can't be read (before any change), picks candidate workouts (date or 20 most recent), takes the first with a GPS polyline and hands it to addUnlessSaved, which appends it to SavedRouteStore (or reports it already saved) and returns the record.

branches.effect: returns .missing notRecorded 'no workout on <date>' or 'no recent workouts in archive'
returns .missing invalidParameter 'no GPS polyline …'; otherwise returns addUnlessSaved's result

flags.text: docs/VOICE_AND_TOOL_USE.md says that without a date save_workout defaults to the most recent finished workout and errors when that workout has no GPS polyline; the code skips non-GPS workouts and saves the newest of the 20 most recent that has a polyline.

units.does: If a saved route already has the same encoded polyline (the same recorded workout), returns status 'already_saved' with that route's id and name and the workout date without adding; otherwise appends the route to SavedRouteStore and returns savedRouteRecord (status 'saved').

branches.cond: a saved route has the same encodedPolyline
branches.effect: returns status 'already_saved' with the existing route; nothing is added

units.does: Returns the trimmed 'date' arg, or nil when absent/empty.
Maps the saved route and source entry to status 'saved', id, name, sport, distance, ascent, climb_count and from_workout_date (ISO8601).
Async action entry 'routes.library.engage' (name) calling resolveRoutesLibraryEngage.
units.entry: fact closure runs when the LLM calls tool 'routes.library.engage' (FactResolverRegistry.resolveTool/resolveActionTool, FactResolverRegistry.swift:291/348); property read when the namespace's entries list is built

units.does: MainActor: validates name, requires exactly one case-insensitive name match and a cached fix ≤60 s old, then builds and engages the saved route.

branches.effect: returns .missing notRecorded 'couldn't get a current location fix'; otherwise engages

units.does: Refuses a saved route whose polyline decodes to fewer than two trackpoints (notRecorded, 'can't be followed; asking again won't help'); otherwise builds the synthetic step list (3 s cap), nil → notRecorded 'still building … ask again'; else engages ActiveRouteSession and returns engaged record.
MainActor: when the saved route's polyline decodes to fewer than two trackpoints returns missing(notRecorded) saying it can't be followed and retrying won't help; nil otherwise.
Calls ActiveRouteSession.engageSyntheticRoute with the build's steps, totals, label and destination.
Envelope for a non-unique name match: ≤1 match (i.e. 0) → notRecorded 'no saved route named …'; >1 → invalidParameter 'multiple saved routes share the name'.

branches.effect: false: notRecorded no such route; true: invalidParameter multiple matches

units.does: Runs SavedRouteStepBuilder.build(savedRoute:currentLocation:) in a 3 s FactResolveTimeout race; build keeps running after timeout to warm OSM tiles.
Maps a BuildResult to status 'engaged', name, direction, distance, duration, step_count, has_unnamed_turns and first_instruction.
